title: Appointment Setter / Sales Representative
description:
About SO Good



SO Good is a fast-growing Texas-based marketing company helping local businesses dominate Google Maps, Google Search, and AI search.



We are looking for a competitive, results-driven Appointment Setter / Sales Representative who can prospect, follow up, book qualified demos, and close deals.



This is not a customer service role. This is a hunting role.



Compensation & Contract



Base Pay: $200 per month, paid biweekly via Wise.



Contract: Initial 3 months, with an opportunity to extend based on performance.



Commissions:



50% of onboarding fees ($500 per business unit at current pricing), paid after onboarding is completed.

5% recurring client revenue while the customer remains active and you continue working with SO Good.



Bonuses:



$500 for every 10 deals closed within one month.

$25 for every cold-sourced lead that attends a scheduled demo.



Commissions are uncapped. Sales commissions apply to deals closed or officially credited to you.



What You Will Do:



Build and manage a database of 3,000+ prospects.

Complete 75 to 100+ outbound touches daily through calls,
s, texts, and DMs.

Qualify prospects and schedule demos with business owners.

Follow up consistently and handle objections.

Conduct sales demos and close deals when assigned.

Track activities, appointments, and sales in Google Sheets.

Follow SO Good's sales process and meet performance targets.



What We're Looking For:



Strong spoken and written English.

Confident communicating with U.S. business owners.

Comfortable with cold calling and rejection.

Competitive, persistent, organized, and self-motivated.

Coachable and able to follow instructions.

Experience in appointment setting, B2B sales, or digital marketing is a plus.



Remote Work Requirements:

Reliable internet, computer, and headset.

Quiet and professional workspace.

Availability during scheduled hours overlapping with U.S. Central Time.

Responsive and dependable during working hours.



How to Apply:



Answer the following questions:



What is your experience in cold calling, appointment setting, or sales?

What is the highest number of outbound calls you've made in one day?

How do you handle a prospect who says, "I'm not interested"?

How would you convince a business owner to attend a demo?



Required: Include a 1 to 2-minute  video introducing yourself and explaining why you're a strong fit.



We care more about grit, accountability, and results than an impressive resume.



If you can prospect, follow up, book appointments, and close, apply today.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

title: Land Acquisition Closer
description:
If you're an experienced closer who enjoys negotiating, wants a steady pipeline of opportunities, and prefers spending time closing rather than searching for leads, we'd like to hear from you. We are an established land investment company that buys and sells vacant land directly from owners across the U.S.



The Role

* You'll own the conversation from the first real call to a signed purchase agreement. Our team and marketing find the sellers; you close the deal. You'll work with two types of leads:

* New leads: sellers who have just shown interest.

* Follow-up leads: sellers from earlier conversations who haven't made a decision yet.

This is a phone-based sales role.



Why Work With Us

* Warm leads, every day. A steady flow of new and follow-up sellers, so you can focus on closing deals instead of prospecting.

* Focus on what you do best — closing. Our team handles marketing, lead generation, and transaction coordination, so you can concentrate on working with sellers and getting deals across the finish line.

* Established and stable. Join a U.S. land investment business with established systems, a proven process, and consistent deal flow.

* Competitive earnings. Earn a reliable base rate plus commission, with opportunities to increase your income as you perform.

* Training and ongoing support. Onboarding, SOPs, deal walkthroughs, and coaching to help you succeed.

* Room to grow. Take ownership of your pipeline, deepen your real estate experience, and grow your responsibilities and earnings as the company grows. We value accountability, professionalism, and strong performance.



What You'll Do

* Call and follow up with new seller leads quickly, ideally within minutes.

 * Work a pipeline of older leads on a consistent schedule.

 * Negotiate terms and close purchase agreements with sellers.

 * Send purchase agreements and follow up until they're signed and returned.

 * Hand signed deals off smoothly to our title and transaction team, and keep the seller informed until closing.

 * Log every call, note, and next step in the CRM so no lead falls through the cracks.



What we are looking for

* At least 2 years of sales experience with a demonstrated history of closing deals, ideally in real estate acquisitions or phone-based sales.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
CONTRACT UI/UX DESIGNER



=== ABOUT ESHOPPING GROUP ===



We're an e-commerce success story with operations across Sydney, Perth, and Brisbane, and an international team of 50+ spanning Australia, US, Philippines, Vietnam, China, and UK. Our portfolio includes seven brands across Beauty, Consumer Electronics, Pets, Surveillance, and Wellness. We operate out of WeWork on Pitt St with a flexible, fast-paced culture that rewards initiative and creativity.



=== WHY JOIN US? ===



- International team: Collaborate with 50+ people across six countries.

- Career growth alignment: We invest in people with vision and ambition.

- Expert mentoring: Learn from leaders recognised as Top 50 People in Australian ecommerce.

- Shared success: Your performance directly contributes to business growth.



=== THE ROLE ===



As we continue to scale multiple brands, we are seeking a Contract UI/UX Designer to join our team part time. This role sits within our in-house creative team and is ideal for a hands-on designer with strong UI/UX, ecommerce, and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) experience. You'll enjoy solving digital problems across multiple brands and turning ideas into intuitive, high-performing experiences.



You'll work closely with our Design & Experience Lead and broader creative, ecommerce, marketing, and product teams, taking ownership of digital projects from brief through to final design and developer handover.



A key part of the role will be supporting and executing our CRO program. You'll be expected to set up and launch A/B tests using platforms such as Elevate, Intelligems, or similar tools, conduct pre- and post-experiment data analysis, and translate insights into actionable design and optimisation recommendations.



=== KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ===



- UI/UX Design: Design and improve digital experiences across multiple ecommerce brands, including landing pages, website pages, collection experiences, navigation, and other website enhancements.



- Landing Pages & Website Design: Own projects from brief and initial UX thinking through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI design, prototyping, and developer handover, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and commercially effective.



- UX & Customer Journeys: Map customer journeys, identify friction points, and translate user needs, behavioural insights, and business objectives into clear, intuitive digital experiences.



- CRO & A/B Testing: Identify optimisation opportunities, develop data-informed hypotheses, design test variations, and independently set up, configure, and launch A/B tests using Elevate, Intelligems, or similar experimentation platforms.



- Pre- & Post-Experiment Analysis: Establish performance baselines, assess opportunities using existing data, monitor experiment performance, and analyse results to evaluate outcomes and identify actionable recommendations for ongoing conversion optimisation.



- Design Systems: Work within and contribute to existing design systems and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency while adapting digital experiences to suit different brands and audiences.



- Shopify Design: Design and support front-end improvements across Shopify websites, with a strong understanding of the platform's capabilities and limitations.



- Creative Collaboration: Work closely within the creative team alongside digital designers, graphic designers, copywriters, and content creators to deliver cohesive, high-quality digital experiences.



- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, ecommerce, product, development, and data teams to deliver design solutions that balance user needs, brand, and commercial objectives.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===



- 2-4 years' experience as a UI/UX or Digital Designer, ideally within ecommerce, agency, or fast-paced digital environments.

- Strong practical experience designing for ecommerce websites, with a portfolio demonstrating real-world website, landing page, and UX work.

- Advanced Figma skills, with experience creating wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and developer-ready handovers.

- Strong Shopify experience and a solid understanding of working within Shopify's front-end environment.

- Hands-on A/B testing experience, including setting up, configuring, and launching experiments in Elevate, Intelligems, or similar CRO and experimentation platforms.

- Confident with pre- and post-experiment data analysis, including establishing performance baselines, evaluating test results, interpreting key ecommerce metrics, and making data-informed recommendations.

- Strong understanding of CRO principles, experimentation methodology, hypothesis development, and how to design tests that balance user experience with commercial objectives.

- Strong understanding of UX principles, information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and responsive design.

- Ability to take ownership of projects from brief through to final design and developer handover, while working independently and managing deadlines.

- Comfortable balancing user needs, brand requirements, and commercial objectives when making design decisions.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

- Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how front-end designs are implemented is highly beneficial.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, brands, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



=== HIGHLY REGARDED ===



- Experience using GA4, Rebuy, and other ecommerce analytics and optimisation tools.

- Experience using customer data, behavioural insights, user research, and qualitative feedback to identify conversion opportunities.

- Experience working across multiple brands or sub-brands.

- Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems.

- Experience utilising AI-powered tools to support design, research, ideation, or creative workflows.



=== BENEFITS ===



- Competitive remuneration package based on experience.

- Professional development and mentoring.

- Fast-paced, innovative, and dynamic culture.

- Shared success model: your wins are the business's wins.



=== HOW TO APPLY ===



If this sounds like the role you've been waiting for, we want to meet you! Submit:



- Your CV.

title: Full time Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:

ABOUT THE BUSINESS:

Our goal is simple: Get the right content in front of the right audience and turn attention into qualified leads and sales.**



We work with a specialist team of media buyers, graphic designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and marketing professionals to deliver high-performing campaigns for our clients.



 ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Coordinator to take ownership of coordinating client marketing campaigns from planning through to launch.



You will work closely with clients and our internal delivery team to ensure campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, high quality, and ready to perform.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Campaign Management

s, and calls to action**.

* Ensure campaigns are as strong as possible before going live.



Content & Optimisation

 copy, headlines, and calls to action** when required.

* Ensure messaging is clear, compelling, consistent, and aligned with the campaign objective.



Problem Solving & Launch



* Identify roadblocks, missing information, risks, and issues early.

* Proactively solve problems and escalate issues when necessary.

* Conduct final campaign checks before launch.

* Organise and document all campaign assets and information.

* Provide a clear handover to the Media Buyer for post-launch management and optimisation.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



You will use:



*GHL— CRM

*Zoom — Meetings & client communication

*Loom— Screen recordings

*Slack— Team communication

*ClickUp— Project management

*Gmail —

*Google Drive— File management

*Google Sheets — Tracking & reporting



Experience with these tools is an advantage, but we can provide training.



REQUIREMENTS



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Has 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, project management, lead generation, or a similar role.

* Understands paid digital advertising and lead generation.

* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Can confidently communicate with clients and internal team members.

* Has strong problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership abilities.

* Is proactive and takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Has excellent attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

* Enjoys working with creative, marketing, and technical specialists.

* Is eager to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibility.



The Type of person we're looking for:



We are looking for someone who:



*Thinks ahead.

*Takes ownership.

*Spots problems early.

*Solves problems proactively.

*Communicates clearly.

*Pays attention to detail.

*Works well with others.

*Wants to learn and improve.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We will train you on our systems and processes.

What we do need is someone with the attitude, initiative, and work ethic to become exceptional at the role.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful when:



* Campaigns launch on time with minimal delays or last-minute issues.

* Projects are organised and everyone knows what they are responsible for.

* Campaigns are high quality with strong and consistent messaging across every touchpoint.

* Problems are identified early and resolved proactively rather than becoming larger issues.

* Clients are well communicated with and feel confident that their campaigns are being managed professionally.

* Team members have what they need to complete their work efficiently.

* Campaign handovers are complete and organised allowing Media Buyers to take over smoothly.

* You consistently identify opportunities to improve campaigns, messaging, and processes**.

* You require progressively less supervision because you understand what needs to be done and take initiative.

* Ultimately, the campaigns you coordinate contribute to quality leads, sales, and measurable growth for our clients.**



The ultimate measure of success:



*Clients are happy.

*Campaigns launch on time.

*The work is high quality.

*The team is organised.

*Problems are solved before they become problems.

*Our campaigns generate results.**







HOW TO APPLY

3. Your experience with paid advertising and/or lead generation.

4. Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

title: Install Coordinator for a US HVAC Company (Full-Time, Mon to Fri, US Eastern Hours)
description:
The job at a glance

- Pay: $6 to $7 USD per hour, based on experience. Extra pay is possible if you have a mechanical engineering background or hands-on HVAC or mechanical trade experience.

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time

- Philippine time: 7:30 PM to 6:00 AM (8:30 PM to 7:00 AM from November to March)

- Starts with: our daily team huddle at 7:30 AM ET

- Breaks: 30-minute lunch, plus short breaks as the day allows

- Weekends: on-call shifts rotate among the VA team, depending on the season and team size



Hi! I'm JP, the owner of EnviroAir. We're a heating and air conditioning company near Raleigh, North Carolina. We install and repair HVAC systems for homes, rentals and small businesses. Our office team works remotely from the Philippines.



I'm looking for an Install Coordinator. Once a customer signs, you take the job from there until it's done and paid. You'll text and call customers, builders and town inspectors all day. The work is fast-paced, and you'll report to our Job Cost Coordinator.



What you'll do

- Schedule installs and follow-up visits, and confirm dates with customers

- Apply for North Carolina permits, book inspections, and make sure we fix anything the inspector asks for

- Text customers before and after their install, including rebate and warranty forms

- Follow up with customers who still have a balance on their install

- Answer our commercial line and book maintenance visits for property managers

- Book oil changes and repairs for our work trucks



Tools: OnCall Air, Housecall Pro, Quo (phone and texting), Google Workspace and Fleetio. You don't need to know them all yet. We'll show you.



Why work with us

- You work for the owner directly, not an agency. I talk with our team every day.

- We train you with written steps and short videos, so you're never guessing.

- This is a full-time, long-term job with a US company, not a short project.

- We're a small team, so your work shows. When you clear a permit, you'll see the crew go out and finish the job.



What you'll need

- Strong written and spoken English, clear enough for American customers on the phone

- At least 1 year of scheduling or coordinating work for a US company (home services, construction, property management or similar)

- Available for the full schedule above, including your turn on weekend on-call

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- A noise-canceling headset and a quiet place to work. We'll check your audio on your recording and on the interview call.



Nice to have

- Experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber or a similar app

- Experience with US building permits or inspections

- A mechanical engineering degree, or hands-on HVAC or mechanical trade experience (this can mean higher pay)



How to apply

I'd love to hear from you! Please send all 3 items below. It takes about 20 minutes, and we can only review applications that include every item.



1. Use this subject line: INSTALL COORDINATOR - [your first name]



2. Write two short answers.

   a. A property manager texts us: "Hi, this is Dana from Oakline Properties. Your technician is scheduled for the maintenance visit at 4410 Atlantic Ave tomorrow at 9 AM. Our building engineer is out. Can we move it to next week? Tuesday or Wednesday morning works." Write your text reply to Dana.

   b. Yesterday the town inspector failed our install at 118 Birchwood Ln because the condensate drain line has no trap. Write a short message to our install technician, Jon, so he fixes it and we can book the reinspection.



3. Record a 60 to 90 second voice recording or Loom video and paste the link in your application. The question: An install was scheduled for 8 AM. It's now 10:30 AM and the crew hasn't arrived. The homeowner calls you. She's upset because she took the day off work. Tell us what you'd say to her and what you'd do next.



We reply to every complete application within 5 business days. Thanks for reading, and I hope to hear from you!



JP

 (high ticket preferred)

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR...



:)  A standalone house, farmhouse, rest house, or private residential property surrounded by nature.

:)  Genuine privacy is our highest priority. Ideally, no immediate neighbors, nearby houses, or properties above the home.

:)  A generous amount of surrounding land, trees, farmland, or open space.

:)  A comfortable, livable house with electricity, running water, and reliable internet (or ability for us to have StarLink).

:)  Accessible by an ordinary vehicle throughout the year.

:)  Suitable for long-term rental rather than short-term vacation stays.

:)  Pet-friendly (two indoor cats).



LOCATION...



We're looking for rural properties in Luzon, within a maximum of approximately 4 hours' driving distance from Metro Manila in any direction. We're particularly interested in peaceful agricultural communities, mountain foothills, and countryside locations with plenty of open space and privacy.



We're flexible about the province, but the 4-hour-ish driving limit is important because we need reasonable access to Metro Manila, including the airport and government services.



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR...



:(  Subdivisions, gated communities, or densely populated neighborhoods.

:(  Homes with immediate neighbors or shared residential compounds.

:(  Properties along busy roads or surrounded by commercial activity.

:(  Vacation resorts that aren't available for long-term rental.

:(  Homes that appear private in photographs but are actually surrounded by other houses.



HOW THE REFERRAL FEE WORKS...



If you introduce us to a suitable property and we ultimately sign a rental agreement, we'll pay you ₱10,000 upon signing the lease! You don't need to be a real estate agent. Perhaps a relative owns an unused farmhouse, a neighbor has a vacant countryside property, or you simply know someone who might be willing to rent their home.



We're particularly interested in privately owned properties that may not be advertised online.



This is not an hourly position or a request for online property research. It's a referral opportunity with a one-time payment for a successful introduction.



INTERESTED? LET'S TALK!



If you know of a property that might be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you! You don't need to have everything ready when you first contact us. A simple introduction about a potential property is perfectly fine.



However, anyone pursuing the ₱10,000 referral fee will be responsible for contacting the property owner, confirming their willingness to rent long-term, and gathering the information we need to evaluate the property. This includes photos of the house and surrounding area, the proposed rental price, and a Google Maps location pin so we can examine the property and its surroundings using satellite imagery.



Privacy is extremely important to us, so being able to verify the property's location and proximity to neighboring houses is essential before arranging a viewing. We're happy to discuss promising leads, but we're looking for someone who can help facilitate the introduction and communication with the owner, not simply provide a name or address.



We're actively searching and will be traveling to view properties this weekend, so promising leads may have an opportunity for a viewing on short notice!



Thanks so much!!

Cold Calling: Contact prospective clients, introduce SO Good, identify potential needs, and generate interest in our services.

Lead Qualification: Determine whether prospects are a good fit before scheduling a sales call.

Appointment Setting: Book qualified meetings directly for our Sales Closer.

CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointment statuses.

Follow-Up Management: Establish a consistent follow-up process for prospects who are interested but not ready to schedule.

Process Improvement: Monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve the outbound system.

Proven experience in B2B cold calling and appointment setting.

Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with business owners.

Experience building and managing outbound prospecting systems.

Ability to explain a detailed, repeatable cold calling process.

Experience with lead generation, qualification, objection handling, and follow-ups.

Highly organized, proactive, and capable of working independently.

Comfortable tracking performance through measurable KPIs.

title: Real Estate Cold Calling
description:
Summary

Acres & Acquisitions** is a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in off-market residential properties and real estate wholesaling.



We are looking for **experienced real estate cold calling specialists** to join our growing acquisitions and lead generation team.



This is a long-term opportunity for motivated individuals who have previous experience cold calling U.S. homeowners, identifying motivated sellers, and generating qualified leads for real estate investors.



**We are NOT looking for beginners or general appointment setters. We want candidates who understand the U.S. real estate wholesaling industry.**



### Responsibilities

- Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. property owners using our dialer and provided lead lists.

- Identify motivated sellers interested in selling their properties.

- Qualify leads based on the four key factors: **Motivation, Condition, Timeline, and Asking Price.**

- Build rapport with homeowners and professionally handle objections.

- Identify potential opportunities involving distressed properties, vacant homes, inherited properties, landlords, and other motivated sellers.

- Accurately document conversations, seller information, and lead dispositions in our CRM.

- Schedule appointments or transfer qualified sellers to our acquisitions team.

- Follow up with interested homeowners as assigned.

- Consistently meet daily and weekly performance targets.

- Participate in coaching, call reviews, and quality assurance sessions.

- Follow applicable calling, consent, and Do Not Call compliance requirements.



### Requirements

- **Minimum 1 year of proven real estate cold calling experience**, preferably in U.S. wholesaling.

- Previous experience working with real estate investors, wholesalers, or motivated-seller campaigns.

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong communication skills.

- Ability to build rapport, overcome objections, and confidently speak with U.S. homeowners.

- Familiarity with predictive dialers such as WAVV, Readymode, Mojo, or similar platforms.

- Experience using real estate CRMs. (Go High Level)

- Strong understanding of motivated seller qualification.

- Reliable internet connection, professional headset, and quiet working environment.

- Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

- Comfortable with performance tracking, call recording, and accountability.



### Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience with U.S. wholesale real estate companies.

- Experience with live transfers to acquisition representatives.

- Familiarity with vacant properties, absentee owners, probate, pre-foreclosure, and distressed seller lists.

- Experience working with high-volume outbound campaigns.

- Previous success generating qualified seller leads that resulted in signed purchase contracts.



### Compensation

- Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

- Potential performance-based bonuses for qualified leads and results.

- Long-term opportunity with consistent work for strong performers.

- Opportunities to advance into lead management, acquisitions, or team leadership.



### How to Apply

1. How many years of experience do you have cold calling for U.S. real estate wholesalers?

2. Which real estate investment or wholesaling companies have you worked with?

3. Which dialers and CRMs have you used?

4. How many qualified motivated seller leads did you typically generate per day or week?

5. Are you comfortable working U.S. business hours?

6. What is your expected hourly rate?



**IMPORTANT: Please include a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating your spoken English.**



If available, also provide a sample real estate cold call recording that you have permission to share.



We are looking for dependable, experienced professionals who want to grow with a serious real estate investment company.

title: Real Estate Cold Call Manager
description:
**Acres & Acquisitions** is a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in off-market residential properties and real estate wholesaling.



We are looking for an **experienced Real Estate Cold Calling Manager / Team Leader** to oversee, train, and manage our outbound cold calling department.



This is a long-term leadership opportunity for someone who has successfully managed cold calling teams targeting U.S. homeowners and understands how to consistently generate qualified motivated seller leads for real estate wholesalers.



**We are NOT looking for a general virtual assistant, beginner supervisor, or someone whose only experience is making cold calls. We need a proven manager who understands real estate wholesaling, outbound dialing operations, team accountability, and lead generation performance.**



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Cold Calling Team Management**

- Manage a team of 8–10+ offshore real estate cold callers.

- Oversee daily attendance, schedules, productivity, and agent performance.

- Conduct daily team huddles and performance reviews.

- Ensure agents consistently follow approved calling scripts and qualification procedures.

- Identify underperforming agents and implement coaching or improvement plans.

- Assist with interviewing, onboarding, and training new cold callers.



**2. Dialer Management & Optimization**

- Oversee daily operations using predictive dialers such as WAVV, Readymode, or similar platforms.

- Monitor dialing activity, contact rates, live conversations, and agent utilization.

- Help manage calling lists, campaign settings, and lead dispositions.

- Identify issues involving phone number reputation, spam labeling, and declining contact rates.

- Coordinate with dialer providers to troubleshoot technical or campaign performance issues.

- Ensure proper dialer and CRM usage across the team.



**3. KPI Tracking & Accountability**



Track, analyze, and report the following performance indicators:



- Total dials per agent.

- Contact and answer rates.

- Meaningful seller conversations.

- Qualified motivated seller leads generated.

- Qualified leads per agent per day.

- Lead-to-appointment or live-transfer conversion.

- Agent talk time and productive dialing time.

- Lead rejection rates and reasons.

- Attendance, adherence, and agent productivity.

- Overall team performance and trends.



Provide daily KPI reports and weekly performance summaries with clear recommendations for improvement.



**4. Call Quality Assurance & Coaching**

- Review recorded calls daily to evaluate agent performance.

- Conduct one-on-one coaching and group training sessions.

- Improve objection handling, seller qualification, rapport building, and conversation quality.

- Identify common mistakes and develop corrective training.

- Conduct regular roleplays and performance assessments.

- Ensure leads meet our acquisition department's qualification standards.



**5. Lead Quality & Acquisitions Coordination**

- Ensure agents properly qualify sellers based on **Motivation, Property Condition, Asking Price, and Timeline**.

- Review lead notes for accuracy and completeness.

- Coordinate with our acquisitions department to identify why leads are accepted or rejected.

- Improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisition representatives.

- Help reduce unqualified leads, duplicate submissions, and poor CRM documentation.

- Monitor lead generation results and make data-driven recommendations.



**6. Hiring, Training & Department Growth**

- Assist in recruiting experienced real estate cold callers.

- Conduct interviews and live calling assessments.

- Train new agents on scripts, dialer usage, CRM procedures, and lead qualification.

- Develop standard operating procedures and training materials.

- Help scale the department while maintaining quality and consistency.



### Required Qualifications



- **Minimum 1 years of experience managing outbound cold calling teams.**

- Direct experience working with **U.S. real estate wholesalers or real estate investment companies**.

- Proven experience supervising at least 5 cold callers.

- Strong knowledge of motivated seller lead generation and qualification.

- Hands-on experience with predictive dialers such as WAVV, Readymode, Mojo, or similar systems.

- Ability to analyze dialing performance, contact rates, and lead conversion metrics.

- Experience with call monitoring, quality assurance, coaching, and agent development.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience using real estate CRMs and reporting dashboards.

- Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

- Reliable internet connection and professional working environment.

- Understanding of applicable Do Not Call, consent, and outbound calling compliance requirements.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing Egyptian or Filipino real estate cold calling teams.

- Previous experience scaling a team from 5 to 10+ agents.

- Familiarity with live transfers to acquisition closers.

- Experience managing multiple shifts or shared dialer seats.

- Knowledge of lead list segmentation, campaign optimization, and phone number reputation management.

- Experience developing KPI dashboards and QA scorecards.

- Experience collaborating directly with acquisitions managers.



### Compensation & Opportunity



- Competitive compensation based on management experience.

- Potential performance-based bonuses tied to verified lead quality and team results.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. real estate investment company.

- Opportunity to help build, optimize, and scale an entire cold calling department.



### How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your proposal:



1. How many years have you managed cold calling teams specifically in U.S. real estate wholesaling?

2. What is the largest number of cold callers you have directly managed?

3. Which predictive dialers and CRMs have you managed?

4. What daily and weekly KPIs do you use to evaluate cold calling performance?

5. How many qualified motivated seller leads did your previous team generate per week, and with how many callers?

6. What steps would you take if a caller consistently produces high dial volume but very few qualified leads?

7. Have you managed morning and evening shifts using shared dialer seats?

8. What is your expected monthly compensation or hourly rate?



**IMPORTANT: Please include a 60–90 second voice introduction explaining your previous real estate cold calling management experience.**



If available, provide a sample KPI dashboard, anonymized performance report, or quality assurance scorecard from a team you previously managed.



We are looking for a **hands-on, performance-driven leader** who can take ownership of our cold calling department, improve agent productivity, and consistently deliver qualified seller opportunities to our acquisitions team.



**Acres & Acquisitions**  

Real Estate Investment & Wholesaling

Requirements

, calendars, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

We're looking for curious, independent writers who enjoy researching unfamiliar topics, questioning information, and turning what they discover into interesting, useful articles.



We manage a growing portfolio of websites covering technology, software, online services, and other industries. We're hiring full-time writers who want to become part of our editorial team for the long term.



This isn't just about writing articles. We want people who can think critically, investigate claims, find reliable sources, and take ownership of their work.



As our websites grow, strong performers may have opportunities to become editors, oversee other writers, or eventually manage their own websites.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Research and write original, well-structured articles on various topics.

- Find reliable sources, verify information, and identify outdated or misleading claims.

- Explain complicated subjects in clear, engaging language.

- Review and improve your work based on editorial feedback.

- Follow content briefs, meet deadlines, and communicate regularly with the team.

- Learn new editorial, SEO, and website management responsibilities as you grow.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong English writing and research skills.

- Curiosity and a willingness to learn unfamiliar subjects.

- Good judgment when evaluating sources and factual claims.

- The ability to work independently and take feedback constructively.

- Attention to detail and a commitment to producing useful, accurate content.

- Reliable internet access and your own computer.



Previous professional writing experience is helpful, but we're more interested in your actual research and writing ability.



You don't need to be an SEO expert or know every publishing tool. We're willing to help the right person learn.



WORK ARRANGEMENTS



- Position: Full-time, remote

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Starting salary: $800 USD per month

- Growth: Potential increase to $1,000 per month based on performance

- Schedule: Flexible, with regular communication and agreed deadlines

- Time tracking: Hubstaff, including periodic screenshots



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete our application form: 



The form asks about your writing background, research process, and editorial judgment. It also includes a short writing exercise.



Please answer the questions yourself without using AI to generate your responses. We want to understand how you actually think, research, and write.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid writing trial.



IMPORTANT: Only applicants who complete the Google Form will be considered.



We're looking forward to hearing from writers who want to grow with our team.

title: Senior Performance Marketer | Meta Ads Expert, Lead Generation & Alex Hormozi Strategies
description:
We are a Canadian automotive financing company looking for a top-level performance marketer and Meta Ads specialist to develop, execute, and scale our customer acquisition strategy.



Our goal is to generate our own high-quality automotive financing leads instead of purchasing leads from third-party providers.



IMPORTANT: You MUST understand Alex Hormozi's $100M Leads, his customer acquisition strategies, lead magnets, offers, and conversion principles. If you are unfamiliar with his methods, do not apply.



Scope of Work:



Develop and execute a complete paid advertising and lead-generation strategy.



Create, launch, manage, and scale high-performing
 and Instagram campaigns.



Apply Hormozi's strategies to lead magnets, offers, messaging, and customer acquisition.



Work with our video production team to develop winning ad hooks, scripts, creatives, and VSLs.



Collaborate with our GHL developer to optimize landing pages, conversion funnels, and lead tracking.



Implement Meta Pixel, Conversions API, retargeting, and conversion attribution.



Continuously A/B test creatives, audiences, offers, and landing pages.



Optimize campaigns for qualified financing applications and actual vehicle sales, not just cheap leads.



Analyze performance, manage advertising budgets, and provide clear weekly reports.



Requirements:



Expert-level Meta Ads experience with proven results generating leads at scale.



Strong knowledge of Alex Hormozi's $100M Leads and practical experience implementing his strategies.



Proven experience managing significant advertising budgets and optimizing customer acquisition costs.



Advanced understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, creative testing, tracking, and conversion optimization.



Experience with GoHighLevel, VSL funnels, and automotive or financial-services advertising is a major advantage.



Ability to work independently, make strategic decisions, troubleshoot problems, and require minimal supervision.



Must be proactive, results-driven, and capable of taking full ownership of marketing performance.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS — READ CAREFULLY



You MUST submit a custom-written cover letter specifically addressing this position. Generic, copied, or mass-produced applications will be automatically rejected.



Your application must include:



Alex Hormozi Knowledge: Explain 3 specific strategies from $100M Leads and how you would apply them to generate automotive financing leads.



Meta Ads Experience: Provide real examples of campaigns you've personally managed, including advertising spend, cost per lead, conversion rates, and measurable results.



Your Strategy: Briefly explain how you would launch and scale our automotive financing campaigns using Meta Ads, lead magnets, VSLs, and conversion funnels.



Proof of Work: Provide screenshots or a Loom walkthrough of actual Meta Ads campaigns you've managed, showing performance metrics. Confidential client information may be hidden.



Availability & Pricing: Include your years of experience, monthly management fee or hourly rate, and availability.



NO BEGINNERS. NO GENERIC COVER LETTERS. NO HAND-HOLDING.



We are looking for a senior performance marketer who can independently take ownership of our customer acquisition strategy, work alongside our GHL developer and creative production team, and consistently optimize campaigns toward profitable vehicle deliveries.



Only applicants who follow all instructions and demonstrate genuine expertise will be contacted.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Social Media Manager to build, organize, manage, and automate our social media presence across multiple platforms.



This role goes beyond simply creating and posting content. The ideal candidate will be responsible for establishing a strong and consistent Rate DNA presence across social platforms, connecting our accounts and marketing tools, creating efficient workflows, and automating repetitive tasks wherever possible.



You will help build a social media system that is organized, scalable, responsive, and designed to generate engagement and qualified leads with minimal manual effort.



Platforms

The Social Media Manager will manage and/or establish Rate DNA's presence on platforms including:

-

- Instagram

- Threads

- LinkedIn

- TikTok

- X 
)

- Nextdoor

- Google Business Profile

- Alignable

- Other relevant social and business platforms as needed



Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Account Setup & Management

- Create, claim, verify, and optimize Rate DNA profiles across all relevant platforms.

- Ensure all accounts use consistent branding, company information, contact details, logos, descriptions, and visual identity.

- Secure accounts using appropriate passwords, permissions, two-factor authentication, and administrator access.

- Maintain an organized record of account access, ownership, and platform credentials.

- Identify additional platforms and directories that may benefit Rate DNA's online presence.

2. Social Media Management & Scheduling

- Set up and maintain a centralized social media scheduling and management system using tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar platforms.

- Build and maintain a monthly content calendar.

- Schedule content across multiple platforms while adapting posts to each platform's format and audience.

- Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

- Monitor scheduled content and troubleshoot publishing issues.

3. Content Creation

- Create engaging social media posts relevant to mortgage, real estate, home financing, interest rates, and related topics.

- Develop graphics using Canva or similar design tools.

- Create and edit short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts when applicable.

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats and platforms.

- Develop educational, promotional, community-focused, and lead-generation content.

- Maintain consistent Rate DNA branding and messaging across all content.

4. Social Media Automation

- Identify repetitive social media and marketing tasks that can be automated.

- Build and maintain workflows for:

- Cross-posting

- Content scheduling

- Automated responses

- DM triggers

- Lead notifications

- Lead routing

- CRM updates

- Internal team notifications

- Connect social media platforms with CRM and other business systems using tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Test automations regularly and troubleshoot failed workflows.

- Continuously look for ways to reduce manual work while maintaining quality and personalization.

5. Lead Management & Routing

- Monitor comments, direct messages, inquiries, and social media leads.

- Respond to basic inquiries promptly and professionally.

- Identify potential sales leads and route them to the appropriate team member or CRM.

- Ensure lead information is captured accurately.

- Create automated lead-routing workflows where appropriate.

- Track the source of leads generated through social media.

6. Community Management

- Monitor comments, mentions, reviews, and messages across platforms.

- Respond to customers and prospects in a professional, helpful, and timely manner.

- Escalate questions or complaints that require management or specialized assistance.

- Monitor brand mentions and relevant conversations.

- Maintain a positive and professional online presence for Rate DNA.

7. Mortgage & Real Estate Compliance

- Ensure social media content follows applicable mortgage and real estate advertising requirements.

- Follow company guidelines regarding NMLS information, Equal Housing Opportunity requirements, disclosures, licensing information, and advertising language.

- Review content for compliance before publishing.

- Work with management/compliance personnel when clarification or approval is required.

- Stay informed about company-specific marketing and compliance requirements.

8. Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor social media performance across platforms.

- Track key metrics including:

- Engagement

- Followers and audience growth

- Reach and impressions

- Website traffic

- Leads generated

- Messages and inquiries

- Content performance

- Prepare a monthly social media performance report.

- Identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

- Provide recommendations based on data and performance trends.

9. Continuous Improvement

- Research new social media features, tools, automation opportunities, and emerging platforms.

- Recommend new tools or workflows that can improve efficiency.

- Test new content formats and strategies.

- Continuously improve Rate DNA's social media presence and lead-generation process.

- Stay current with changes to platform algorithms, policies, and best practices.



Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Strong experience managing multiple social media platforms.

- Experience creating social media content, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Experience with social media scheduling and management platforms.

- Strong understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

- Experience connecting social media platforms with CRMs or other business applications.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple platforms simultaneously.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic technical and automation issues.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with a mortgage, real estate, financial services, or related company.

- Knowledge of mortgage and real estate advertising compliance.

- Experience with NMLS and Equal Housing requirements.

- Experience with CRM platforms and lead-routing systems.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

- Experience with Google Business Profile.

- Experience building automated marketing workflows.

- Basic understanding of SEO and local marketing.

- Experience managing online reviews and business listings.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new platforms.

- Automation-minded and always looking for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Creative and able to produce engaging content.

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Detail-oriented, especially when managing multiple accounts and automations.

- Organized and capable of maintaining a clear content calendar and workflow.

- Analytical and able to use data to improve performance.

- Reliable and responsive when managing comments, messages, and leads.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

- Successful setup and optimization of all required social media accounts.

- Consistency and quality of social media content.

- Growth in followers and engagement.

- Increase in reach and brand visibility.

- Number and quality of leads generated.

- Response time to comments and inquiries.

- Successful implementation of automation workflows.

- Reduction in repetitive manual social media tasks.

- Accuracy of lead routing and CRM updates.

- Compliance with company and industry advertising requirements.

- Timely and accurate monthly reporting.



Working Relationship

The Social Media Manager will work closely with management, marketing, sales, and other team members to ensure that social media activity supports Rate DNA's overall marketing and lead-generation goals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of the social media ecosystem—from account setup and branding to content creation, automation, engagement, lead routing, analytics, and continuous optimization.

title: FULL-TIME Junior Creative Strategist for Fast-Growing DTC Supplement Brand
description:
About Us

We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the health supplement space, scaling with performance-driven creatives. Every ad we launch is backed by data and crafted to convert.



We're looking for a Junior Creative Strategist who thinks in angles, writes with intent, and wants to master the craft of building ads that sell, someone who's hungry to learn, test relentlessly, and grow into a key player on our creative team.



The Role

We're hiring a Junior Creative Strategist who can develop compelling ad concepts with a focus on long-form statics and direct-response copywriting for Meta & Google.



This is a long-term, remote role with a $2,000 - $3,000 base salary (exclusive of performance bonuses). Compensation can increase significantly based on performance.



What You'll Do

- Develop ad concepts and angles for long-form static ads, including advertorials, listicles, comparison statics, and educational formats

- Write direct-response copy — headlines, hooks, body copy, and CTAs that drive action

- Research competitors, audiences, and market trends to find winning angles

- Build creative briefs for designers and video editors to execute

- Work with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Higgsfield to speed up ideation and asset creation

- Analyze performance data and iterate on concepts based on KPIs such as CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS

- Test different angles, formats, and messaging frameworks at volume

- Collaborate closely with the Creative Manager, editors, and designers to push output

- Study winning ads across the DTC space and break down what makes them convert

- Experiment with new formats, storytelling structures, and persuasion techniques



You Need

- Some experience with long-form static ads and/or direct-response copywriting — personal projects or spec work count

- A basic understanding of marketing psychology, hooks, and consumer behavior

- Strong writing skills — you know how to make people stop scrolling and start reading

- Willingness to produce at volume — the target is 30+ static concepts per week

- Hunger to learn — you don't need to know everything, but you need to want to

- Ability to take feedback, move fast, and not get attached to ideas that don't perform

- Bonus: familiarity with the health/supplement space



A proven track record is a massive plus. If you've already worked on ads that performed — even a handful — that puts you ahead of the pack.

We'd much rather see 3 real ads with real results than a polished portfolio with no data behind it.



What You'll Get

- $2,000 base salary, exclusive of performance bonuses

- Compensation can increase significantly based on performance

- Fully remote role

- Direct mentorship and collaboration with experienced strategists, editors, and the Founder

- Managed under a dedicated Creative Manager who oversees strategy and creative output

- A real opportunity to grow into a senior strategist role as we scale



How to Apply

Start your application with the word ANGLE so we know you read the full post.



Then send us the following:

1. Your creative work

Send 3–5 examples of ad creatives you personally concepted, wrote copy for, or strategized — ideally static ads or written content that was used in paid campaigns.

For each example, include:

- A link or screenshot of the final creative

- What product/brand it was for

- What parts you were responsible for — concept, copy, design direction, or full execution

- Whether it ran as a paid ad, and on which platform



Portfolio pieces, freelance work, and spec projects are all acceptable — but real ads with real performance data will always stand out more.



2. Performance evidence — strongly preferred

If any of your work ran as paid traffic, send screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or other platforms showing actual performance.

Where available, we'd like to see metrics such as:

- Spend

- CTR

- CPC

- CPA / Cost per Purchase

- ROAS

- Hook rate / thumb-stop rate



We understand that junior candidates may not always have access to performance data. If you don't, that's okay — just be honest about it and tell us what you do know about how the creative performed.



If you do have data, share it. Proven results carry serious weight in this process.



You may blur client names, account IDs, revenue figures, or other sensitive information. We mainly want to verify that you have experience producing creatives that were genuinely used and tested with paid traffic.



3. Break down a winning ad

Pick any static ad or advertorial you've seen online that you think works well.



In 200–300 words, break down:

- What angle it uses and why it's effective

- How the copy is structured

- What makes someone stop and read it

- What you'd test or change to improve it



This tells us more about your strategic thinking than any resume will.



4. Tell us which tools you use or want to learn

List the tools you currently use or are familiar with for:

- Copywriting and research

- Static ad design — Figma, Canva, Photoshop, etc.

- AI content generation — ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield, etc.

- Ad spying and competitor research

- Organizing and managing creative output



We're particularly interested in strategists who are comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, ideation, and first drafts.

title: Photo Editor (Lightroom Expert): All Industries
description:

HOURS: Project-based. Workload varies per shoot, with potential to grow into full-time.

FULL-TIME: When this grows into a full-time role, the salary is PHP 50,000 to 80,000 per month



I'm Tayo, owner of Astra Vizuals, a small, fast-growing creative agency from the Netherlands. We shoot for European brands in every industry: events, sports, corporate, products, food, real estate and people.



I'm looking for a photo editor I can hand any shoot to, who culls it, grades it and delivers it, so I don't have to think about it anymore. It starts project-based. If we click and the work grows, so does your role.



WHO YOU ARE

WHAT YOU NEED

title: Video Editor – Marketing & Social Media Content
description:

We’re looking for a skilled Video Editor who can take raw footage and turn it into polished, professional and engaging video content.



The work will include a mix of short-form and longer-form videos for social media, websites, advertising campaigns and other marketing channels.



A key part of the role is knowing how to take raw footage that may initially look flat, grey or washed out and properly colour correct and colour grade it so the final result looks natural, bright and professional.



You should also know how to make videos more engaging through strong pacing, transitions, captions, B-roll, sound design and visual effects without making them feel over-edited.



What you’ll be doing

Take longer videos and repurpose them into multiple standalone videos



Identify the strongest hooks, talking points and moments from raw footage



Colour correct and colour grade footage



Improve flat or grey-looking footage so it looks natural and professionally lit



Add captions, animated text, B-roll, transitions and motion graphics



Improve pacing and remove unnecessary pauses or sections



Add music and sound effects where appropriate



Clean up and improve audio



Create engaging openings that capture attention



Adapt videos for different platforms and formats



Edit content for social media, websites and paid advertising



What we’re looking for



You should have strong experience with:



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar professional editing software



Colour correction and colour grading



Marketing and social media video editing



Long-form and short-form editing



Content repurposing



Captions and animated text



B-roll and visual storytelling



Audio clean-up and sound design



Motion graphics and tasteful visual effects



Creating videos that hold attention



We’re looking for someone who understands that great video editing is more than simply cutting clips together.



You should know how to take raw footage and make it feel professional, natural, dynamic and engaging, while keeping the editing style appropriate for the brand and audience.



The type of content



You may work on:



Interviews



Client testimonials



Educational videos



Business owners speaking to camera



Social media videos



Video advertisements



Website videos



Case studies



Promotional videos



Longer videos repurposed into multiple smaller pieces of content



To apply



Please send:



3 direct links to your best recent video edits



The editing software you use



Your availability



Your hourly rate or preferred pricing structure



Please do not send your full portfolio. We would rather review three strong, recent examples of your best work.

title: Google Ads & Meta Ads Setup Specialist | GA4, GTM & Conversion Tracking
description:
Valére Growth Studio is a marketing and growth partner serving dental practices and professional-service businesses throughout the United States.



We are hiring a detail-oriented Google Ads and Meta Ads Setup Specialist for an ongoing, part-time relationship. You will help prepare advertising accounts and campaigns as we onboard new practices and expand existing client campaigns.



This is a technical setup and implementation role. Our team provides the strategy, budgets, targeting requirements, keywords, approved copy, creative, and landing pages. You will configure the accounts, build the approved campaigns, verify tracking, and prepare everything for review by our paid media manager.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review existing advertising accounts and business assets before creating anything new.

• Set up or connect Google Ads accounts and the required Meta business assets.

• Configure approved account access, business information, and platform connections.

• Coordinate billing and verification requirements with our team.

• Build campaigns using our approved budgets, locations, keywords, exclusions, copy, creative, and destination URLs.

• Implement approved conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads, CallRail, and relevant Meta tools where authorized.

• Test landing pages, form submissions, phone routing, booking links, and tracking behavior.

• Identify configuration errors, duplicate tracking, broken links, and missing inputs.

• Document completed work, test results, and any remaining blockers.

• Submit completed campaigns for manager review before activation.

• Support additional approved campaign builds and technical updates as needed.



Website development and ongoing campaign strategy are handled by other team members. You will coordinate with them to ensure the advertising setup and website connections work correctly.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Hands-on experience setting up Google Ads and Meta Ads.

• Practical experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

• Ability to demonstrate conversion-tracking testing and troubleshooting.

• Experience following campaign briefs and implementation checklists.

• Strong attention to detail and clear written communication.

• Ability to organize work across multiple client accounts.

• Ability to follow our approved tracking and data-handling requirements.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Dental, healthcare, or local-service businesses.

• CallRail.

• Agency or multi-location account work.

• Microsoft Advertising, YouTube campaigns, or LinkedIn Ads.

• Basic website and form troubleshooting.



WORK ARRANGEMENT



• Remote, ongoing part-time work.

• Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with workload varying based on practice onboarding and approved projects.

• $10–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

• Working hours, communication overlap, and turnaround expectations will be agreed upon before starting.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief summary of your Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager experience.

2. Two examples of account or tracking setups you personally completed. Remove confidential client information.

3. A short explanation of how you verify that conversion tracking is working correctly.

4. Your experience with CallRail and local-service businesses.

5. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

6. Your answer to this question: A website form submission is being counted twice in Google Ads. How would you investigate the problem?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical exercise.



We value accurate implementation, clear documentation, and dependable follow-through.

title: Executive Assistant – Remote Monitoring | Work From Home | Day Shift
description:
Responsibilities



- Monitor a designated Slack channel for automated system health notifications.

- Review routine component updates to distinguish between normal operation, reported failures, and missing health checks.

- Follow the documented escalation checklist whenever a component fails or an expected update does not arrive.

- Acknowledge alerts promptly and notify the appropriate engineering contact.

- Make urgent phone calls or reach designated escalation contacts when critical alerts require immediate action.

- Document essential i
 information, including the affected component, when the issue occurred, and whether it has happened previously.

- Protect the confidentiality of all information shared in the monitoring channel.

- Stay attentive and responsive throughout assigned shifts, including overnight and weekend coverage.

- Consistently follow approved runbooks, escalation protocols, and response-time requirements.



Role Boundaries



- Troubleshooting, restarting, repairing, or otherwise resolving technical issues is outside the scope of this position.

- You will not access customer systems, servers, or infrastructure.

- You will not communicate directly with end customers.

- Engineering team will manage all technical investigations and corrective actions.



Essential Requirements



- Availability to provide coverage during the required hours: Monday–Friday, 5:00 PM–8:00 AM AEST/AEDT, plus full weekend coverage.

- A dependable internet connection and the ability to monitor Slack actively in real time.

- Ability to follow detailed checklists, runbooks, and escalation instructions accurately.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to respond quickly, including through urgent calls and messages.

- Excellent attention to detail, dependability, and accountability when managing time-sensitive notifications.

- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.



Preferred Experience and Skills



- Previous experience in monitoring, network operations centre (NOC) support, customer service, operations, virtual assistance, or similar roles involving continuous monitoring.

- Familiarity with Slack or comparable real-time communication and monitoring tools.

- Ability to maintain concentration during extended overnight shifts.

- Sound judgment when identifying issues that need immediate escalation.

- Confidence working independently while coordinating with an offshore or distributed team.



Schedule and Working Arrangements



- Monday–Friday: 5:00 PM–8:00 AM AEST/AEDT.

- Saturday and Sunday: 24-hour coverage.

- Slack will be the primary communication platform, with phone calls or other urgent contact methods used for high-severity alerts.

- Before the start date, training will cover the monitoring dashboard, alert categories, escalation procedures, and designated contacts.

- Escalation contacts and expected response times will be confirmed before the selected candidate begins.
